4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-o-n-e-y m-u-l-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-c-c-o-u-n-t d-a-t-a w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-s-o-l-a-t-e-d v-i-c-t-i-m-s f-r-o-m c-o-m-p-a-r-i-n-g n-o-t-e-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g b-l-o-c-k l-i-s-t-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-p-o-r-t-m-a-n-d-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
